_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

columns.name: reason
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (reason IS NULL OR reason IN ('PURCHASE', 'DAMAGE', 'WASTAGE', 'MISSING', 'CORRECTION', 'OTHER'))

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "role" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "selling_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (selling_price_paise >= 0), "cost_price_paise" INTEGER CHECK (cost_price_paise IS NULL OR cost_price_paise >= 0), "stock_quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock_quantity >= 0), "stock_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'COUNT' CHECK (stock_unit IN ('COUNT', 'ML', 'GRAM', 'KG', 'NONE')), "low_stock_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USE_DEFAULT' CHECK (low_stock_mode IN ('USE_DEFAULT', 'CUSTOM', 'OFF')), "low_stock_threshold" INTEGER CHECK (low_stock_threshold IS NULL OR low_stock_threshold >= 0), "membership_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (membership_enabled IN (0, 1)), "member_price_paise" INTEGER CHECK (member_price_paise IS NULL OR member_price_paise >= 0), "image_path" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_variants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "selling_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (selling_price_paise >= 0), "cost_price_paise" INTEGER CHECK (cost_price_paise IS NULL OR cost_price_paise >= 0), "stock_quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock_quantity >= 0), "low_stock_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USE_DEFAULT' CHECK (low_stock_mode IN ('USE_DEFAULT', 'CUSTOM', 'OFF')), "low_stock_threshold" INTEGER CHECK (low_stock_threshold IS NULL OR low_stock_threshold >= 0), "membership_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (membership_enabled IN (0, 1)), "member_price_paise" INTEGER CHECK (member_price_paise IS NULL OR member_price_paise >= 0), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "email" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "receipt_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "subtotal_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (subtotal_paise >= 0), "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_paise >= 0), "payment_method" TEXT CHECK (payment_method IN ('CASH', 'UPI', 'BANK')), "payment_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PAID' CHECK (payment_status IN ('PAID', 'NOT_PAID')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "sale_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sales (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_paise >= 0), "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (payment_method IN ('CASH', 'UPI', 'BANK')), "note" TEXT NULL, "paid_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "reversed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reversed" IN (0, 1)), "reversed_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_paise >= 0), "category" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('SUPPLIES', 'UTILITIES', 'RENT', 'SALARIES', 'MAINTENANCE', 'MARKETING', 'TRANSPORT', 'MISC')), "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (payment_method IN ('CASH', 'UPI', 'BANK')), "payment_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PAID' CHECK (payment_status IN ('PAID', 'NOT_PAID')), "expense_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "product_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_name" TEXT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL, "unit_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price_paise >= 0), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0), "line_total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_total_paise >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_sequences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (next_value >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "movement_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (movement_type IN ('OPENING', 'SALE', 'PURCHASE', 'ADJUSTMENT_IN', 'ADJUSTMENT_OUT')), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity <> 0), "stock_before" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (stock_before >= 0), "stock_after" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (stock_after >= 0), "reason" TEXT CHECK (reason IS NULL OR reason IN ('PURCHASE', 'DAMAGE', 'WASTAGE', 'MISSING', 'CORRECTION', 'OTHER')), "note" TEXT NULL, "reference_type" TEXT NULL, "reference_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "email" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "purchase_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "subtotal_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (subtotal_paise >= 0), "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_paise >= 0), "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchase_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "product_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_name" TEXT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL, "unit_cost_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_cost_paise >= 0), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0), "line_total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_total_paise >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_sequences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (next_value >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_stock_movements_product_created_at ON stock_movements (product_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_stock_movements_variant_created_at ON stock_movements (variant_id, created_at)
